capabilities: copy inline code blocks on click
extras: The README's usage section covers building the plugin from source rather than using it, and an 'Inspired by' mention is followed by no named project.
motivation: The author stores credentials and account details in Obsidian and wanted copying to be a single click instead of select-plus-Ctrl+C.
problem: Copying inline code in Obsidian requires selecting the text and pressing a copy shortcut, which is inconvenient for frequently copied content like credentials.
summary: Click-to-copy plugin that copies the content of inline code blocks with a single click in reading view.
